description: A C# ASP.NET Core controller class 'CommentsController' managing comment-related endpoints for articles, including creating, retrieving, and deleting comments.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: Controller class handling comment endpoints, using dependency injection for mediator, with actions for creating, getting, and deleting comments.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new comment on an article identified by 'slug' via POST request.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves comments for an article identified by 'slug' via GET request.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific comment by 'id' on an article identified by 'slug' via DELETE request.
